messages.title: End
segments: There was once a place where nothing grew. Only water, bones, and things nobody came back for. He walked until the rooms began to repeat.
A word, a joke, an olive, a memory, he kept searching for the things waiting at the end...
... but there was no door, no answer, no one waiting, only the swamp, only the dead.
And behind him, a small fire still burning ... He finally understood.
Nothing had been waiting for him at the end. Everything had been waiting for him along the way. So he stopped searching.
And listened to the fire. It was the only thing in the dungeon that was still alive.
